title: The Monastery – Kloster Eberbach
content: # The Monastery. Panoramic view of Eberbach Monastery with vineyards in the foreground and forest in the background. Historical photograph of the south facade of the basilica at Eberbach Monastery. ## "Our door stands open, even more so our heart". Kloster Eberbach has always been a place of retreat and reflection. The abbey represents medieval architecture like no other place in Hessen and reflects 900 years of society and culture with its unique history. "Our door stands open, even more so our heart" – this Cistercian motto determines our daily activities. Since 1998, Kloster Eberbach has been owned by a non-profit foundation under public law, the "Stiftung Kloster Eberbach". Since 1998 Eberbach Monastery has been owned by a non-profit foundation under public law, whose task is the long-term preservation of the monastery. "The Name of the Rose" made Kloster Eberbach famous worldwide as a film location. The Society Friends of Eberbach Monastery is dedicated to preserving and promoting the historical and cultural significance of the monastery.
